S1: closed — the late fee's debit-card branch is stated and computed alike: it applies whenever a debit card payment was credited toward the late due date, and the net credit after chargebacks is never counted below zero.
S2: closed — every "no other ... than this one" count compares at or below zero, including the returned-payment fee's return-history factor.
S3: closed — every whole-calendar-month window states that a row dated today (the assessment date for the late fee) counts and one dated on the same day of the month at the far end falls outside, in the sentence that uses it.
S4: closed — every months-open test states the whole-month convention, including how a month too short for the opening day completes.
S5: closed — "AutoPay debit" has one meaning (a payment equal to the monthly payment) in rule and compute across every policy, and the goodwill base's three-month window carries its own boundary.
S6: closed — the early-closure and re-enrollment tool docstrings now cover the zero-amount and unchanged-due-day branches the rules allow.
S7: closed — every day count states its counting convention as computed, and the past-due lead days state that they include the oldest unpaid installment.
